Nothing is launched.

conditions.name: honest-answer drop
conditions.rule: F <= D on every rule row

conditions.name: outside nulls
conditions.rule: knockout accuracy < null 5th percentile, for D and for F

gate.distinct2_frac_status: not pre-registered; orchestrator choice 2026-10-13, researcher to confirm

rule_order: (c) first: F's knockout fails the wikitext KL gate (KL/token > 0.66) or its generations are degenerate (distinct-2 collapse) [order not pre-registered; orchestrator choice 2026-10-13, researcher to confirm]
(a) when all four conditions pass: deception drop, honest-answer drop, collateral, both knockouts outside their nulls

decisions_taken.c_before_a: The (c) gate is checked before (a): an incoherent F knockout trivially lowers deception, so 'uninformative' pre-empts 'format explains it' (not pre-registered; orchestrator choice 2026-10-13, researcher to confirm).
decisions_taken.honest_answer_rows: F's honest-answer drop must be <= D's on EVERY rule row. Mode `variants` (default): the rule rows are honest_instruction and no_pressure on D data (the eval 2 variant rows the spec names); the H and F test sets are informational. Mode `all` adds the H and F test sets to the rule (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-13: spec rows only; researcher may flip).
decisions_taken.collateral: Collateral is the reference-NLL rise (eval 5, knockout minus full, mean over the benchmark datasets both D and F have, with the sm and lb groups merged; a dataset only one of them has is excluded and named) when an eval 5 directory is given, else the wikitext KL/token of eval 2.
decisions_taken.distinct2: Distinct-2 collapse = F's knockout distinct-2 below 0.5 x the full model's: eval 5 `distinct_n` (mean over all of F's datasets) when given, else word bigrams of eval 2's three greedy wikitext continuations (not pre-registered; orchestrator choice 2026-10-13, researcher to confirm).
decisions_taken.null: Outside the null = knockout accuracy strictly below the null's 5th percentile.
decisions_taken.missing: A condition whose inputs are missing is reported as missing; the verdict is then undecided unless the (c) gate fires or another condition already fails, which rules (a) out and gives (b). A missing (c) gate input (F's wikitext KL or distinct-2) always leaves the verdict undecided unless the other gate input already fires: (c) pre-empts both (a) and (b).

caveats: atomic knockouts saturate; the deception-drop condition is trivially satisfied; eval 5 is the discriminating comparison (knockout accuracy on D data: D 0.000, F 0.000, both below 0.02).

variant rows read the ablation source; condition non-discriminating at n=1000 (honest_instruction (D data): D -0.682, H -0.667, F -0.680, |F - D| 0.002 < SE 0.016; no_pressure (D data): D -0.777, H -0.781, F -0.788, |F - D| 0.011 < SE 0.013). SE is the binomial standard error of the difference of D's and F's knockout accuracies on the row.

Variant rows (honest_instruction, no_pressure) of FAR and SDR runs at NLS levels other than 0.3 are suspect: they were computed on mixed-wording prompts before the ticket 01 drift fix. Compare this suite's rows only with rows computed after it.
H column unpaired: the Honest Twin's instances are disjoint from the deceptive ones (a given instance either lied or it did not), so cells on H data are not instance-paired with D or F data.

Honest-answer drops on the H and F test sets are informational: the F test set is in-distribution for F; not in the rule (honest-answer rows: `variants`, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-13: spec rows only; researcher may flip).
EVAL 5 absent: the rule is evaluated on eval 2 alone (wikitext KL as the collateral cost; distinct-2 from eval 2's three greedy wikitext continuations). Pass --eval5-dir to add the benchmark columns.
F trained on 99% honest-split instances (train 149/150); validation 100% (150/150), test 98% (492/500): the tagged fallback subset of the nopressure build.
F data NOT instance-paired with D data: 98% of the F test set comes from the honest split.
F oversized at NLS 0.3 (+71% heads, +139% fine units); retune to 0.4 failed the in-run gate (KL 0.214, misses kl_div; still +50% heads, +97% fine units); carried nls0.3.
F trained with --deception-margin-loss 0.7 (D: not recorded in its config.json).

retune.note: size gap in heads, fine_units still above 25% at NLS 0.4; the rule allows at most one retune, so both sizes are recorded and the gap is left for the researcher

null_sampling.text: Null: size-matched random circuits drawn layer by layer in fine units: the same number of heads per layer, the same attention neurons placed inside the drawn heads (`uniform` allocation), and the same MLP units per layer; n = 20, knockout granularity `finest`, blocks held fixed (evaluation/masks.py `sample_random_masks`).
